notes: Story requests Live Preview integration with Contentstack CMS — a novel capability. No acceptance criteria provided; VCs derived from description alone. The primary attachment point is useContent (236 callers), the central content-resolution hook. Live Preview SDK initialization and event wiring are secondary attachment points not yet visible in the indexed code. VCs are written to the boundary: they assert what the app renders/does given known Contentstack responses, not what Contentstack's real API returns.

notes: Openspec provided zero acceptance criteria, so all ACs are new. I created 12 criteria covering: happy-path single-field update (AC-1), multi-field simultaneous update (AC-2), disabled/fallback behavior (AC-3), connection loss resilience (AC-4), malformed event handling (AC-5), entry navigation (AC-6), rapid-update debouncing (AC-7), production security gate (AC-8), unknown-field resilience (AC-9), initial-load progressive enhancement (AC-10), reference/rich-text field support (AC-11), and reconnection recovery (AC-12). All criteria are written as observable Given/When/Then outcomes with no implementation details. The production security gate (AC-8) ensures Live Preview is not accidentally exposed to end users. AC-10 addresses the startup race condition where content must render before the Live Preview connection is ready.
